summary: Verified leaderboard corrupted-row filter fix via Playwright with a mocked Google Apps Script response (page.route intercepts script.google.com/**?action=leaderboard*). All 21 assertions passed: corrupted rows are filtered, numeric course chips are hidden, Moonah Links filter works, and 2BBB shows the empty state.
action_items: Fix upstream root cause: sync the Apps Script header row with the new 'Marker ID' column and add marker_id to the leaderboard JSON so 2BBB pairing works.
Consider prompting/logging when the client filter drops rows (corruption telemetry) so this stays visible.
critical_code_review_comments: leaderboard.ts filter is robust for the three documented corruption signals (empty name+id, numeric course, numeric name).
availableCourses in leaderboard.tsx skips numeric strings — chip row is guaranteed clean.
buildTeams requires mutual marker_id pairing and matching course, so any un-paired surviving row correctly produces the empty state.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Playwright page.route mocks the leaderboard endpoint per test run with 5 rows (2 valid, 3 corrupted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Apps Script currently misconfigured (header not in sync, no marker_id field). Always mock script.google.com/**?action=leaderboard* via page.route when testing /leaderboard. Names are shortened by shortName() -> 'Alex Lee' renders as 'Alex L.' and 'Zos Collaga' as 'Zos C.'. Row testIDs: leaderboard-row-<member_id>. Chip testIDs: course-filter-<course_name> and course-filter-all. Mode toggles: mode-individual, mode-2bbb.
rca_of_issue: Google Sheet rows are column-shifted because a 'Marker ID' column was added without updating the Apps Script header. That caused Member ID to slide into the Name column and Gross/HCP values (e.g. 70, 73, 74) to slide into the Course column. The frontend fix is a defensive normalise-and-drop pass in fetchLeaderboard (drop rows with empty name+id, numeric course, or numeric name) plus a numeric-guard in availableCourses. 2BBB is intentionally empty until the Apps Script starts returning marker_id.
verifications_performed: Alex L. and Zos C. rendered as the only ranked rows
Row with player_name='2327' filtered out (no numeric player-name text rendered as display name)
Course chips: 'All courses', 'Keilor Golf Course', 'Moonah Links' — exactly 3, no numeric chips
Tapping 'Moonah Links' reduces list to only Alex L.
'2 Ball Better Ball' shows 'No pairs playing this course yet.' with zero team rows
